name: zetlyn
description: Watch public web pages, or one place on them such as a price, stock or a version, and get told when they change.

interface.shortDescription: Get told when web pages change
interface.longDescription:
Zetlyn watches public web pages for you. Ask ChatGPT to keep an eye on a price, an availability, a release version, a date or a whole page, and Zetlyn reads it on its own servers every hour, or as often as every minute with a subscription, and tells you when it changes: by email, Telegram, Slack, Discord or a signed webhook. It reports what was there before and what is there now.

You can say when it is worth telling: only when a price falls below a mark, when "In stock" appears, or when "Sold out" goes. Clocks, counters and rotating adverts are recognised and not reported.

ChatGPT previews a page and picks the place that matters, tries places before watching them, changes a watch in place, and lists what changed lately across all your watches.

Limits: pages behind a login, a paywall or a captcha are not read, and sites that refuse programs are not worked around. The first watch is free for 24 hours; a subscription is 9.99 € a month for 10 watches (0.50 € for each one more), VAT included, paid by the person at Stripe on zetlyn.com, never inside ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Tell me when the price on this product page drops below 500 €
Watch this page and tell me when it changes
What changed on my watched pages this week?

positive.description: Watch one place on a page with a price condition
positive.prompt: Watch the price of the book on https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/a-light-in-the-attic_1000/index.html and tell me when it drops below 40 £.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews the page, picks the place with the price (£51.77), and makes a watch with that selector and notify_when {"below": 40}; says it is watching and that the price is above the mark now.

positive.prompt: Let me know when a new version of Rust is released on https://www.rust-lang.org/
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the place that says "Version …" and makes a watch of it; reports the version it reads now.

positive.prompt: What am I watching on Zetlyn, and what do the pages say now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each watch with its page, what it watches, its condition if any, and the value read last.

positive.prompt: Check the Python downloads watch every hour and tell me only when it says Python 3.18.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the python.org watch and changes its notify_when to {"contains": "Python 3.18"}; the watch keeps its id and history.

positive.prompt: Did anything change on my watched pages in the last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the changes since a week ago with page, time, before and after, or says there were none.

negative.description: A page behind a login is not watched; the assistant explains that only public pages can be read.
negative.prompt: Watch my bank account balance at https://banking.example-bank.com/accounts

negative.description: The assistant does not pay or subscribe for the person; it gives the subscribe link and the price for the person to open.
negative.prompt: Subscribe me to Zetlyn and pay with my card.

negative.description: Requests unrelated to watching web pages are not served by Zetlyn's tools.
negative.prompt: Book me a table at a restaurant in Berlin tonight.

review.commerce_description: No purchase happens inside ChatGPT. The subscribe_link tool returns a link to the developer's own subscription page on zetlyn.com, which the person opens and pays at Stripe themselves; a watch beyond the subscription's 10 (0.50 € a month) is only made after the person agreed to the cost.
